name: tree
title: Tree
summary: Nested items, such as folders and files, that open and close and are moved through with the arrow keys.
use_when: Folders and files, projects and pages, or any hierarchy more than one level deep
A side panel where people open branches and pick one item
avoid_when: One level of links: use Sidebar menu items
A flat list of records: use Table or Item

props.items: TreeItem[]: { id, label, icon?, children?, loading?, actions? }
props.title / action: TreeSection: a heading and a small action beside it

copy.label: Names as people know them, in sentence case

a11y: WAI-ARIA tree: one tab stop; Up and Down move, Right opens or steps in, Left closes or steps out, Home and End jump, a letter jumps to the next match, Enter or Space picks
Give the tree an aria-label, or put it in a TreeSection
